name: Nagyatád (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nagyatád: a blue and green shield with a white church, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagyatád arms with helm, crest and mantling
